message: You know, I’ve always been the gloriously over-prepared one in the family — I like to think of it as a charming quirk rather than a mild obsession. When a storm rolls in and the heat cranks up, it’s nice to have a little cheat sheet to remind me of the smart moves we can make. Better to be that extra layer of ready than to be sweating it out, right? What’s your go-to tip for staying cool when things heat up?
